meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发智能体的特殊工作模式,加载预先设定的规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Codex 且希望它遵守你的自定义工作规则
copy.tagline_en: Trigger a special agent mode and load its predefined rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want it to follow your custom working rules.

howto.what: 激活后进入『ultrawork』编码模式：首行显示 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!，然后要求先定目标与成功标准，用『先失败测试、后实现、再真实操作验证』的流程，并全程记录。一切结论都要有证据。
howto.when: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发，之后按该模式的整套流程接管任务。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 修这个问题：先失败证据，再修复验证。
say.note: 它会先登记目标并写失败测试再动手。

say.text: 开 ulw 模式加个新接口，按 LIGHT 流程走。
say.note: 它会先做任务分级再规划步骤。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 检查这次改动，真实跑一遍页面留证据。
say.note: 它会用浏览器真实操作并截图留证。

howto.what_en: Strict mode: prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', requires a goal, success criteria, notepad, failing-first tests (RED→GREEN), and real-surface QA via HTTP/browser/terminal. Claims need evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'; the hook injects the bootstrap and the full mode applies.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork: failing proof first, then fix and verify.
say_en.note: It registers the goal and writes a failing test first.

say_en.text: Enable ulw and add an endpoint, LIGHT tier.
say_en.note: It classifies the task and plans in the notepad.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork to review this change with real browser evidence.
say_en.note: It runs browser QA and captures a screenshot.
